- Every app of Pulse is now also an app of its own (Files, Calculator, Music, Video, Keyboard, YTXTube, Code, Books, Game Hub, Clock, Office, Notes, Weather, Messages, the Launcher, Pulse Core and the others): each installs beside Pulse with its own icon and opens straight into that app. They are all in this release, with Pulse itself (full, lite, mini, 32-bit) and Pulse Watch.
